name: Universal Beta Splatting
definition: A unified framework that generalizes 3D Gaussian Splatting to N-dimensional anisotropic Beta kernels for explicit radiance field rendering, enabling controllable dependency modeling across spatial, angular, and temporal dimensions.
summary: Universal Beta Splatting is a unified radiance field framework that generalizes 3D Gaussian Splatting using N-dimensional anisotropic Beta kernels to model complex light transport and dynamics without auxiliary encodings.
